sources_read: rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 6 and Internal Quality Checks row 6
evidence: No unreachable requirement, and no public sentence whose second reasonable reading is punished by a criterion, was found; bounded ambiguities and an evidence gap remain. REACHABILITY: every graded capability is reachable from the image plus the public internet. environment/Dockerfile:1,9-12 gives Node 22, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (file identical to the frozen template Dockerfile; same versions in tests/Dockerfile); task.toml:22,38 set network_mode public in both phases. The golden needs prettier, acorn, @lezer/html and react (solution/app/package.json), obtainable only over the network, which the public workbook row and the skill delivery profile allow (the Internal sheet's row 6 still says 'no network'; the current profile governs). Launch facts used by tests/test.sh:97-111 (node /app/server.js or a writable copy, env -i with NODE_PATH, PORT=3000, DB_PATH, cwd /tests) are stated in integration.md:3,5,9 ('a working directory that may be outside /app', 'If DB_PATH is set, open that absolute path instead, including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app'); the symlink zeroing at test.sh:72-83 is stated at integration.md:11. Hard items checked: endless source loop with a responsive page (parser-based loop guards, golden runtime.ts:33-56), rejection line numbers (Error stack / unhandledrejection, runtime.ts:113,229), fetch rejection and storage isolation (sandboxed iframe plus CSP connect-src 'none', runtime.ts:7,378), eval/Function/WebAssembly/Worker/import refusal (CSP plus static check), restoring typed values and canvas pixels (runtime.ts:8-20), real clipboard on a non-form surface (clipboard events; ui.md:3 allows 'A small input solely for keyboard or clipboard plumbing'). MEASURED: the scripted golden on these bytes passes every check in results/editor.json, runtime.json and polish.json; I re-hashed runtime.json (e47b63b0...), editor.json (0e98f453...) and tests/runtime.cjs (705726ed...) and they match the index. That shows one implementation satisfies the brief under scripted Playwright with paste-event fixtures; it is not a configured-judge or target-model measurement of these bytes. The only hosted evidence is an earlier candidate (Oracle 0.9833; GPT-5.6 Luna 0 because Run never worked), so achievability by a builder within agent timeout_sec=7200 with the scored suites run is unmeasured, hence risk=true. AMBIGUITIES (reported as the row requires): (1) behaviour.md:3 'show a useful error message there with a one-based line number for a thrown error, including an error inside a complete HTML file, counted from the first line of that file, and a Promise rejection that nothing handles; the message is the text of the Error or rejected value' - whether 'with a one-based line number' covers the rejection depends on parsing a long list, and 'rejected value' admits non-Error values that carry no stack. cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line (scored/functional/judge.toml:239-246, weight 1.5) fails 'if the line number is missing or wrong'. The dominant parse does require the line and the criterion only uses new Error, so this is a wording weakness rather than a defect. (2) behaviour.md:3 'The browser may execute supported code in the preview; the editor must continue to hold the exact source used for Run' - 'supported code' is undefined and it is unclear whether instrumenting the source (needed for loop guards) is permitted; no criterion depends on it. (3) Whether the console is cleared on each Run is unspecified; criteria tolerate both ('console lines from the first Run may still be listed', judge.toml:218). (4) behaviour.md:5 'until that run settles' is undefined for Promises that never resolve and for listeners; criteria exercise only timers. (5) security.md:3 'must not be able to reach the network from the preview: fetch requests ... must fail' leaves open whether script src or img subresources of a complete HTML file must be blocked; only fetch is graded. (6) ui.md:7 'select a word with a double click' gives no word-boundary rule while the judge picks its own fixture (functional/prompt.md: 'You may choose the exact fixture text'), so a fixture with punctuation-adjacent identifiers could be judged against an unstated boundary. (7) Tab indent width and the reply to a replayed restore are open and the criteria accept any ('gains the same indent'; 'After the second request no fifth revision may exist'). (8) The builder is not told the grading browser is headless Chromium with no clipboard-read grant; an editor that pastes through navigator.clipboard.readText() instead of the paste event may work for a person who accepts the prompt but not for the judge. The plumbing-input allowance points at the working route, so this is a latent hazard only (not executed).
counterexample: Not a Fail. Closest case: a builder who reads behaviour.md:3 as 'line number for thrown errors; unhandled rejections reported with their message' logs 'Unhandled rejection: <message>' without a line and fails cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line (weight 1.5) while satisfying everything else in the notes.
suggested_fix: Optional wording repair in behaviour.md:3: split the sentence, for example 'A thrown error and an unhandled Promise rejection of an Error each show the message and the one-based line where the Error was created; in a complete HTML file the line is counted from the first line of that file', and delete or clarify 'The browser may execute supported code in the preview'. Obtain a configured judge run and a target-model run on these bytes before treating achievability as measured.
